svg.desc: Real orange Lamborghini photograph, original left-facing profile. Original baked-in Boss Dog watermark crosses the lower body and rear tyre, so those overlapping pixels are retained. This is an honest photo cutout, not a clean reconstructed wheel; inspect before activating in the hero rotation. Uniform scale preserves proportions. Original photo: Orange.jpg. Native SVG clipping over unchanged embedded photograph; no AI generation or invented branding.
